Four Dead in Telangana Car Crash After Ganesh Immersion

Four people died when their car crashed in Telangana while returning from Ganesh idol immersion. The incident occurred as the occupants were traveling back after participating in the Ganesh Visarjan festivities. The car, identified as an Innova, was reportedly speeding at the time of the accident. All four occupants of the vehicle sustained fatal injuries.
